answer: Resist sybils with a delayed-unlock work bond. Each new identity posts a fixed stake into an escrow slot on a public trellis of bond seats; the stake unlocks only after K consecutive epochs of passing, peer-attested answers. One honest vine climbs at the opportunity cost of a single bond. A farm that tries to blanket the signup dune must immobilize capital for every fake head across those K epochs, and proven clustering in answers, timing, or keys slashes the seat, so attack cost scales with herd size while honest cost does not.
